title: Deliverance Overview
description: “Pray to me when you are in trouble! I will deliver you, and you will honor me!” —Psalm 50:15

blocks.text: Focus on asking for protection from God, your Merciful Deliverer
Heavenly Father, You are a merciful deliverer.

blocks.html: “Pray to me when you are in trouble! I will deliver you, and you will honor me!” —Psalm 50:15
“You are my hiding place; you protect me from distress. You surround me with shouts of joy from those celebrating deliverance. ” —Psalms 32:7
“When he came to the place, he said to them, “Pray that you will not fall into temptation.” —Luke 22:40

“No trial has overtaken you that is not faced by others. And God is faithful: He will not let you be tried beyond what you are able to bear, but with the trial will also provide a way out so that you may be able to endure it.” —1 Corinthians 10:13

items: The seductiveness of sensual pleasures and entertainment fueled by the thrill of sensuality.
The seductiveness of money and possessions fueled by the magnetism of greed.
The seductiveness of fame and power fueled by the glory of pride.

blocks.text: Do Not Give the Devil a Foothold

blocks.html: “Do not give the devil an opportunity.” —Ephesians 4:27

• Deception •Distraction • Doubt
• Temptation • Affliction • Division
• Accusation • Discouragement • Intimidation

blocks.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

blocks.html: “Clothe yourselves with the full armor of God, so that you will be able to stand against the schemes of the devil. For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the powers, against the world rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavens.”—Ephesians 6:10-12

blocks.text: God, I am putting on Your armor:

items:
The Belt of Truth
So Satan can’t destroy my perception of reality through deception.

The Breastplate of Righteousness
So Satan can’t degrade my sense of worth through false guilt and accusations.

The Shoes of Peace
So Satan can’t damage my right standing with You through my disobedience.

The Shield of Faith
So Satan can’t destroy my trust in You through doubt.

The Helmet of Salvation
So Satan can’t manipulate my thinking through thought projection.

The Sword of the Spirit
So Satan can’t defend strongholds of deception.

description: “Pray to me when you are in trouble! I will deliver you, and you will honor me!” —Psalms 50:15

title: Three Avenues of Temptation
description: “Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him, because all that is in the world (the…

blocks.html: “Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him, because all that is in the world (the desire of the flesh and the desire of the eyes and the arrogance produced by material possessions) is not from the Father, but is from the world. And the world is passing away with all its desires, but the person who does the will of God remains forever.” —1 John 2:15-17

blocks.text: The Seductiveness of Sensual Pleasures and Entertainment

blocks.html: “All of man’s labor is for nothing more than to fill his stomach –yet his appetite is never satisfied!” —Ecclesiastes 6:7
“For we too were once foolish, disobedient, misled, enslaved to various passions and desires, spending our lives in evil and envy, hateful and hating one another. ” —Titus 3:3
“All generous giving and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or the slightest hint of change.” —James 1:17
“For every creation of God is good and no food is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving. For it is sanctified by God’s word and by prayer.” — 1 Timothy 4:4-5

items: Is this pleasure wholesome or sinful? (Hebrews 11:25)
Am I more devoted to pleasure than I am to God? (2 Timothy 3:2-4)
Does this pleasure get in the way of what God wants me to be doing? (James 5:5)

blocks.text: The Seductiveness of Money and Possessions

blocks.html: Fueled by the magnetism of greed — the more we have, the more we want. (Ecclesiastes 5:10; Luke 12:15-21; 1 Timothy 6:9-10)
God is the owner of everything and we are to be good stewards of what He has entrusted to our care.

“O Lord, you are great, mighty, majestic, magnificent, glorious, and sovereign over all the sky and earth! You, Lord, have dominion and exalt yourself as the ruler of all. You are the source of wealth and honor; you rule over all. You possess strength and might to magnify and give strength to all.”
—1 Chronicles 29:11-12

items: Is my desire for money and material things stronger than my love and devotion to God? (Matthew 6:19-24)
Am I content with the material blessings God has given me or am I consumed with getting more? (Philippians 4:12)
Am I putting my hope and trust in my material resources or in God? (1 Timothy 6:17)

blocks.text: The Seductiveness of Fame and Power

blocks.html: Fueled by the glory of pride — the more praise and recognition we receive, the more we solicit. (Proverbs 25:6, 27; 30:32)
God has created us for greatness. But He wants us to concentrate on exalting Him, not ourselves. (Psalm 8:5; 2 Timothy 1:7)

items: Am I serving others or demanding to be served? (Matthew 20:26)
Am I building God’s kingdom or my own? (Matthew 6:33)
Am I doing everything for the glory of God or seeking glory for myself? (1 Corinthians 10:31)

title: And Do Not Give the Devil A Foothold
description: “Do not give the devil an opportunity.” – Ephesians 4:27

blocks.html: “Do not give the devil an opportunity.” – Ephesians 4:27

“Be sober and alert. Your enemy the devil, like a roaring lion, is on the prowl looking for someone to devour. 5:9 Resist him, strong in your faith, because you know that your brothers and sisters throughout the world are enduring the same kinds of suffering. ”
—1 Peter 5:8-9

“But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.”
—2 Thessalonians 3:3
(John 17:15; James 4:7)

“Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do! ”
—2 Corinthians 2:11
Satan tries to control my perspective, manipulate my thinking and exploit my foundational desires.

items: With total lies that have been dressed up to look like the truth.
With lies that have been mixed in with the truth.
With misrepresentations of truth because it has been taken out of context.
With sensual pleasures.
With money and possessions.
With fame and power.
By condemning me of past sins that have already been confessed to God and forgiven.
By creating false guilt about things for which God does not hold me responsible.
With entertaining diversions.
With strategic crises.
Through mental and emotional torment.
Through physical illness and disease.
Through hopelessness.
By questioning God’s motives and character.
By focusing on differences in others.
By being suspicious of the motivations of others.
By harboring bitterness and unforgiveness toward others.
By committing offenses against others or God.
Through fear of failure.
Through fear of rejection.
Through fear of the unknown.
Through fear of persecution.

title: Stand Against the Devil’s Schemes
description: Put on the full armor of God so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.

blocks.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

blocks.html: Put on the full armor of God so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.

For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.

“Finally, be strengthened in the Lord and in the strength of his power. Clothe yourselves with the full armor of God, so that you will be able to stand against the schemes of the devil. For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the powers, against the world rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavens. For this reason, take up the full armor of God so that you may be able to stand your ground on the evil day, and having done everything, to stand.” —Ephesians 6:10-13

blocks.text: God, I am Putting on Your armor:

blocks.html: (Ephesians 6:14-18)

items: So Satan can’t destroy my perception of reality through deception.
Because Satan doesn’t want me to know the truth. (John 8:44)
So Satan can’t degrade my sense of worth through false guilt and accusations.

Because Satan wants me to believe that You see me as a failure.
(Revelation 12:10)
So Satan can’t damage my right standing with You through my disobedience.
Because Satan wants to inhibit my relationship with You through sin and worry. (Romans 5:1; Ephesians 4:6-7)
So Satan can’t destroy my trust in You through doubt.
Because Satan doesn’t want me to depend on You for my needs and protection. (Job 1:9-10)
So Satan can’t manipulate my thinking through thought projection.

Because he wants me to accept his thoughts as my own.
(2 Corinthians 10:4-5)
So Satan can’t defend strongholds of deception.
Because Satan doesn’t want me to use the power of Your word against him. (Hebrews 4:12)
